fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Terrain; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with posts or reflective delineators on both sides to define the entry point under low-light or smoky conditions.
• Create a designated turnaround area near the residence large enough for fire apparatus and ambulances to reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Keep the full width of the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and vegetation so apparatus can reach the residence without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a secondary parking area away from the residence where arriving responders can stage vehicles without blocking the access drive.
• Keep the parking area near the residence clear during emergencies so the closest approach to the structure remains open for fire and medical apparatus.
• Trim any vegetation along the access drive that reduces vertical or horizontal clearance for large emergency vehicles.
• Post the property address visibly at the residence itself in addition to the driveway entrance, so responders who reach the building can confirm the correct location.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Single Access Route; Long Driveway; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Isolated Structure
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs on all sides of the structure to increase open space between the plants and the building.
• Remove any shrubs or plant material growing directly against the exterior walls.
• Thin scattered shrubs nearest to the structure to reduce the amount of connected plant material leading toward the building.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches and shrubs along its full length to allow emergency vehicles to pass through without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate quickly from the road, given the property's single access route and isolated location.
• Maintain the existing open areas between vegetation and the structure by preventing shrubs from expanding or growing back into those cleared zones.
• Clear any dead or dry plant material from around the base of shrubs located near the structure.
